name: PowerSGD with two power iterations
tagline: Per-2D-tensor low-rank PQ approximation with warm-started Q, two power iterations and a QR re-orthogonalization, plus error feedback; small/1D tensors bypass compression.
init_recovers: topk_ef baseline at rank=1 (for trivially low ratios) and identity for small tensors
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the topk_ef baseline's element-wise sparsifier with a PowerSGD-style low-rank projector: 2 power iterations, warm-started Q, QR orthogonalization, residual error feedback, and bypass for small/1D tensors.

name: TopK + 8-bit stochastic quantization
tagline: Top-k sparsification with 1.33x more elements (because retained values are 8-bit), stochastic-rounding quantization to int8, and momentum-based error feedback.

key_hyperparams.name: extra_factor
key_hyperparams.role: extra TopK fraction allowed by 8-bit values

init_recovers: topk_ef baseline at extra_factor=1, n_levels→∞, ef_beta=0
diff_from_baseline: Combines the topk_ef baseline with QSGD-style 8-bit stochastic quantization on the retained values (allowing 1.33x more entries within the same bit budget) and a momentum-decayed error feedback buffer.

name: AdaSQ-EF with factorized momentum
tagline: Per-layer adaptive top-k budget allocated by EMA error magnitude, 8-bit stochastic quantization on the values, masked local momentum, and a server-side momentum-override decompressor.
init_recovers: topk_ef baseline when adaptive budget falls back to per-layer k and quantization is disabled
diff_from_baseline: Major extension of topk_ef: replaces fixed per-layer k with EMA-error-driven adaptive budget across layers, adds 8-bit stochastic quantization, locally masks the momentum on transmitted entries, and uses a momentum-override decompressor that turns the compressed cumulator into a pseudo-gradient.

name: Channel-balanced row-wise TopK + EF
tagline: Reshape weights to [out_dim, *] and TopK per output row instead of globally; small/prediction layers go dense; residuals are clipped to ≤ 4x of the gradient norm.

key_hyperparams.name: dense_threshold
key_hyperparams.role: numel below which compression is bypassed

key_hyperparams.name: prediction_threshold
key_hyperparams.role: numel cap for keeping prediction-layer dense

key_hyperparams.name: residual_clip
key_hyperparams.role: max EF residual norm relative to gradient norm

init_recovers: topk_ef baseline when compression is global rather than per-row
diff_from_baseline: Refines the topk_ef baseline by sparsifying *per output channel* (no class/filter starvation under 100x), bypassing compression on tiny or prediction layers, and norm-clipping the error-feedback residual.
